title: analysis.classify_markers params and result
description: AI-marker classification over the TEAM ANALYSIS activity items: one pass building the adoption signal (aggregate_ai_markers) and one collecting every AI-marked evidence sample (_collect_samples, no limit). Called BEFORE the change-metadata fetch so the caller's insights thread can consume signal+samples concurrently with that fetch — which is why this is a separate method from analysis.score_code. Pure by contract: no DB, no network, no clock. Reference implementation: src/yeaboi/analysis/aggregate.py::classify_markers (build_classify_inputs builds the params). Result key order is contractual (contract_version, signal, samples; signal's field order as listed below).

activity_item.description: A normalized activity dict from the collectors, sent VERBATIM. The classifier reads kind ('commit'/'pr'/'review'/'comment'), title, body, author, branch, source, key, url; unknown keys pass through untouched.

signal.description: aggregate_ai_markers' own fields only, in exactly this key order. footprint_pct is Python round(x, 1) — banker's. per_* are count_pair lists; sources_scanned preserves first-seen order. Provenance labels (repos_scanned, and the overwrite of sources_scanned) are caller-side and never on the wire.

samples.description: Every AI-marked item (never bodies), item key order: author, tool, activity, title, source, key, url. title is truncated to 80 CODE POINTS (Python slicing, not bytes).
